_note_spipe_removed: 2026-09-13: the 'spipe' entry was removed from here; the plugin now ships from the repo-root marketplace 'simple-plugins' (/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json) as './examples/05_stdlib/spipe'. It could never install from here: './plugins/spipe' is a git symlink (mode 120000, materialized on Windows as a SYMLINKD to ..\..\..\..\examples\05_stdlib\spipe), and Claude Code refuses any marketplace entry that leaves the marketplace directory. Measured on Windows 2026-09-13, install reported success but the plugin was inert: 'Error: Path escapes plugin directory: ./plugin/skills/ (skills) — it resolves to C:\Users\ormas\dev\simple\examples\05_stdlib\spipe\plugin\skills, outside the marketplace directory'. A probe with an explicitly climbing source drew the categorical refusal naming a 'link-traversing entry', so this is a path-shape rejection, not a Windows-only symptom. Copying the tree in was rejected as a fix: examples/05_stdlib/spipe is 9.1 MB and mcp/ imports ../../src/**, so a partial copy installs but its MCP server dies at spawn. Sourcing from the repo root keeps a single copy and traverses no link (examples/ and examples/05_stdlib/ contain no reparse points). Verified by uninstall -> install -> 'claude plugin list': no Error line, Status enabled, and 'claude mcp list' shows plugin:spipe:spipe Connected from the real path. STILL LATENT, not fixed here: './plugins/obsidian-search' is a junction to tools/claude-plugin/obsidian-search and has the same defect; it is simply not installed on this machine, so it has never surfaced.
